segments.text: Of flying to God in disquiets of soule. Eight observations out of the text.
WHat if neither the speech of others to us, nor the rebuke of our owne hearts will quiet the soule; Is there no other remedy left?

Yes, then looke up to God, the Father and fountaine of comfort, as David doth here; For the more speciall meanes whereby he sought to recover himselfe, was by laying a charge upon his soule to trust in God; for having let his soule runne out too much, hee begins to recollect himselfe againe; and resigne up all to God.
